title: AgentResult
description: What every specialist agent returns. One shape, so the Root Cause Agent never has to guess a format.

status.description: Three states, not two. no_data means the agent ran and found nothing to report; error means it could not run. Merging them turns could-not-check into checked-and-clean.

error.description: Required in words when status is error. A silent error is the defect this whole schema exists to prevent.

findings.description: Observed facts, not interpretations. A finding must be traceable to a specific field of the observation it came from.

source_ref.description: Where in the observation this came from, e.g. pods[0].containerStatuses[0].lastState.terminated.reason. A finding with no ref is an opinion.

hypotheses.description: What the agent thinks might be going on. Deliberately separate from findings so the Root Cause Agent can weigh them differently.

code.description: The named causes a hypothesis may propose. Kept equal to the incident schema's root_cause_code minus INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, which is a verdict about a whole incident rather than a hypothesis an agent can hold. Two consequences of them drifting apart, both found on 2026-09-05: a code an incident cannot record makes a hypothesis nobody can act on, and a cause no agent may propose makes a scenario unsolvable - CPU_THROTTLING was recordable while no agent could suggest it. tests/agents.test.ts requires the two lists to agree in both directions, and requires the prompts to list them.

supported_by.description: Which findings back this. Each entry must be a non-empty source_ref: minItems alone was satisfied by a list holding one empty string, which is support by nothing wearing the shape of support.

contradicted_by.description: Recorded, not dropped. Confidence scoring reads this and lowers the score. Each entry is a non-empty source_ref and is traced back to a finding exactly like supported_by: Codex, chunk 0 round 11 — only the supporting side was checked, so a hypothesis could be weakened by contradictions that no finding reports, or by an empty string.

confidence.description: How much this agent trusts its own hypotheses. 0.0 is a legitimate answer.

allOf.description: An agent that errored must say why, and must not smuggle findings out alongside the error.
no_data means nothing was found. Findings alongside no_data is a contradiction.
A hypothesis without a finding cannot exist: the agent must have observed something first.
status ok must not carry an error text. Otherwise a failed agent reports findings and an error at once, and readers pick whichever they prefer.
